packageRules.description: The custom manager below owns values.yaml image digests. helm-values keys off image.tag, which this chart leaves empty, so it cannot update the digest pins and only adds redundant, empty-tag extractions. Disable it.
Actions are SHA-pinned; group them so one PR moves the whole set, matching what dependabot did before.
CI tooling pinned in workflow env blocks. Grouped: they are only ever used together, and one PR per scanner is noise.
Helm itself gates the support matrix. Separate PR so the major line is a deliberate decision, never a group side effect.

Chart images, grouped into one PR: an image bump changes what users run, and the chart version has to move with it. groupName batches every values.yaml digest into a single branch; the branch-mode postUpgradeTask then runs bump-chart-version.sh once, so the whole batch is one chart patch bump (and one appVersion refresh) rather than a bump per image. Without the postUpgradeTask a digest-only PR fails ci.yaml's version job. Allowed via RENOVATE_ALLOWED_POST_UPGRADE_COMMANDS in renovate.yaml.
kind node images are digest-pinned against a specific Kubernetes line; never move them across minors automatically.

customManagers.description: Image digests in values.yaml. The helm-values manager cannot be used here: it keys off image.tag, and this chart pins by digest with tag left empty so that the digest always wins in searxng.imageRef. packageName is the full registry/repository ref so the docker datasource resolves it directly -- capturing a bare-host registryUrl instead makes Renovate reject it ("Invalid regex manager registryUrl") and the digest lookup fails.
Tool versions pinned in workflow env blocks, e.g. `TRIVY_VERSION: 0.73.0`.
